name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
notes: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps (clockwise). Raceway loop. Traced 6867 m vs 7004 m. Start line on the short straight between the Bus Stop chicane and La Source. One DRS zone on the Kemmel straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
